comments.author: @ZukileFongoqa
comments.text: Tswanas, tell me as a South African with my Rands can I use it in botswana like as I used it in namibia or I will need to change it into your pula?

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Short answer: you'll need pula. Unlike Namibia, Botswana left the rand zone back in 1976, so rand isn't legal tender there — a few shops in the border towns may take it at a poor rate, but don't count on it. Change at a bank or bureau de change once you cross, or draw pula from an ATM.
